launch: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for RimWorld Elemental Hearts living flight launch/arrival animation. Create ONE strict 4 by 4 grid atlas on a square transparent 1024x1024 canvas (each cell 256x256), no gutters, no labels, no text. Sixteen aligned chronological frames of a single polished magical launch vortex. Center of each frame exactly at the cell center. Top-down tilted elliptical luminous seal with several elegant concentric air rings and narrow upward energy wisps. Frames 1-4: delicate ring gathering inward, 5-8: energy tightening into a bright open-centered launch seal, 9-12: ring expands with a decisive upward burst and thin tapering white lift streaks, 13-16: soft expanding shockwave breaks into sparse fading motes, then dissolves. The pawn itself is NOT part of this effect. Neutral ivory white and cool pale gray only, so C# shaders can tint the shared effect gold, yellow, crimson or storm white for each lineage. RimWorld friendly painterly 2D VFX, clean intentional shape, strong readable silhouette, soft restrained glow, real semitransparent edges. Leave about 15% empty space around each frame so nothing is clipped or overlaps its cell. All frames share identical camera, projection, pivot and scale, and the ring grows smoothly through the sequence. No background, no checkerboard, no characters, no pod, no spacecraft, no scenery. Genuine alpha transparency.
marker: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: RimWorld world-map living-flight pawn marker, single transparent game icon. A clean compact ivory-white silhouette of ONE flying RimWorld pawn, viewed in three-quarter side view, tilted diagonally upward toward the upper right. A simple round oval head without facial features; broad compact headless-no-neck torso and short split cape streaming behind, no visible separate arms or legs, matching RimWorld pawn proportions. Clearly a flying person with a cape, no wings, vehicle, pod or aircraft. Two or three tapered motion trails behind the pawn toward the lower left, with a subtle luminous outline. Crisp shape and restrained gray contour for excellent visibility at 32 to 64 pixels on the terrain of a world map. Neutral grayscale only so runtime colors can match Celestial gold, lightning yellow, hell crimson and tempest silver. Centered square composition filling 75% of the canvas. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no ground plane, no shadow, no border, no text, no logo. Polished readable 2D painted game UI sprite, no ornament that could be confused with a spacecraft.
